assumptions: Each f_j is L-smooth and mu-strongly convex on Euclidean R^d; 0<mu<L; kappa=L/mu.

Oblivious canonical linear iterative methods only: iterates are sums of oracle outputs; oracle parameters and index-selection rules may be random but cannot depend on previous oracle answers. Side information n,L,mu is public.

statement.conclusion: Theorem 2 gives soft-Omega(n+sqrt(n(kappa-1))*log(1/epsilon)) iterations. The displayed theorem suppresses normalization-dependent logarithms/constants: it is not promoted here to an explicit joint all-parameter bracket.
statement.objects_and_definitions: A CLI maintains states w_i and generates w_i^(k+1) as sums of O_f(w_j^(k);theta_ij^(k)); oblivious theta laws do not depend on acquired answers. Complexity is the least K making expected function error <epsilon for every instance and all k>=K.
statement.parameter_domains: Theorem 2 small-epsilon asymptotic with n,L,mu and normalization fixed; d>=2 for coordinate-minimization construction.
statement.quantifiers_and_randomness: For every oblivious, possibly randomized CLI, a member of the finite-sum class attains the lower-bound obstruction.
